title: Elite Canon of the Twin-River Orb
summary: Teaches Xiantian students to run two streams of qi through the orb like twin rivers meeting at the strike.

title: Treatise on the Hawk's Iron Fall
summary: Perfects the steep stoop of the spiked head, with qi laid down the shaft ahead of the falling blow.

title: Paired Orb and Shaft: An Elite Reading
summary: Treats orb and shaft as a pair, each guarding what the other leaves open, for the Xiantian student.

title: The Azure Heights Crushing Round
summary: Teaches a flowing round of crushing strokes that rises and falls like the flight of the azure sky.

title: Dual-Track Orb Mastery Canon
summary: Brings both tracks of qi, body and field, fully to the spiked orb in a manual for the advanced Xiantian.

title: Basin Court Treatise on Orb Falls
summary: Describes the orb falls of the basin court, in which each stroke fills the gap the last one made.

title: Wind-Sworn Elite Orb Canon
summary: Sets the full elite round of the wind-sworn spiked orb, driven by qi that moves like the plateau wind.

title: Treatise on the Plateau Crushing Gale
summary: Teaches heavy strokes of the orb that come in on a gale of qi across open ground.

title: Oath of the Falling Head
summary: Binds each downward stroke of the spiked head to the wielder's sworn word, for the Xiantian student.

title: Bearing-True Spike Manual of the Long Reach
summary: Holds a true bearing through the longest reach of the shaft, so the spikes land on the sighted point.

title: Canon of Orb Work Without Walls
summary: Teaches the orb as a weapon of open ground, reaching out in every direction with no cover and none needed.

title: Gale Plateau Treatise on Shaft and Spike
summary: Joins shaft and spike under a gale-driven stream of qi in the finest strokes of the Gale tradition.
